audit_findings.title: Gross cash may include customer-funded operating float
audit_findings.magnitude: $502.688 million cash added; $904.722 million advanced billings and $356.929 million project-related accruals at 2026-06-30; maximum bridge exposure $17.46/share
audit_findings.mechanism: The equity bridge adds all cash without identifying the portion required to fund customer contracts, reimbursable project costs, or minimum operating liquidity.
audit_findings.evidence: Advanced billings represents cash received from customers, or billed amounts per an agreed upon payment schedule, in advance of services being performed or revenue being recognized.
audit_findings.explanation: The gross-cash addition is demonstrated, but the amount that is truly excess is unresolved. Advanced billings exceed cash and increased alongside project-related accruals, so a meaningful portion may support future performance obligations. The maximum exposure equals 6.2% of base equity value and 8.8% of bear equity value, making the issue reasonably capable of materially changing the valuation.
audit_findings.action: Reconcile June 2026 cash by contract against advanced billings, project-cost accruals, restricted or designated customer funds, and minimum operating liquidity; replace gross cash with demonstrably excess cash and rerun every scenario and the buy-below price.

audit_findings.title: The anchor contains a stock-price-dependent excess tax benefit
audit_findings.magnitude: $40.852 million reduction in 2025 tax expense, equal to 9.4% of the $435.6 million OE anchor; if fully embedded, computed operating-value effect is approximately $486-$798 million, or $16.88-$27.72/share
audit_findings.mechanism: An excess tax benefit included in the anchor raises equity-level OE and is then capitalized through forecast growth and terminal value.
audit_findings.evidence: The actual tax benefits recognized related to stock-based compensation totaled $ 50.1 million, $ 27.8 million and $ 18.9 million for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively.
audit_findings.explanation: The $40.852 million tax-expense benefit is demonstrated; whether OE separately normalized it is unresolved. Because it depends on award exercises and share-price appreciation, treating the full amount as recurring could materially inflate both explicit-period cash flows and terminal value.
audit_findings.action: Trace the 2025 OE calculation to the tax provision, determine the embedded excess-benefit amount, establish a normalized cash tax rate excluding nonrecurring option windfalls, and rerun all scenarios and the buy-below price.

audit_findings.title: Uncertain-tax liabilities may be an omitted claim on equity
audit_findings.magnitude: $31.0 million at 2025-12-31, comprising $22.7 million of uncertain-tax liabilities and $8.3 million of related interest and penalties; $1.08/share and 0.38% of base equity value
audit_findings.mechanism: Any past-period tax claim not captured in forecast cash taxes would require a deduction from the equity bridge.
audit_findings.evidence: As of December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively, the Company has a liability for interest and penalties of $ 8.3 million and $ 6.7 million that is associated with related tax liabilities of $ 22.7 million and $ 20.3 million for uncertain tax positions.
audit_findings.explanation: The liability is demonstrated, although its June 2026 balance and settlement amount are unresolved. Even deducting the entire filed $31.0 million reduces base value by only $1.08 per share, versus $282.44 per share, and cannot materially change the valuation conclusion absent a much larger unreported exposure.
audit_findings.action: Obtain the June 2026 uncertain-tax rollforward and expected settlement range; confirm whether forecast cash taxes include settlement, and deduct any uncovered amount from the bridge without double counting.

audit_findings.title: OE capitalizes government assistance of uncertain duration
audit_findings.magnitude: $24.5 million in 2025, equal to 5.6% of the OE anchor; full normalization would have a computed operating-value effect of approximately $291-$479 million, or $10.12-$16.62/share
audit_findings.mechanism: Government incentives reduce operating expenses, raising anchor OE that is subsequently grown and capitalized into terminal value.
audit_findings.evidence: The Company recognized government assistance income, net of $ 24.5 million, $ 20.7 million and $ 15.5 million during the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively.
audit_findings.explanation: The $24.5 million benefit and its inclusion as an expense reduction are demonstrated. The record does not establish which tax credits, grants, and abatements are durable; receivables extending through 2029 show that at least some benefits have finite realization schedules. Continuing the full amount indefinitely is reasonably capable of materially overstating value.
audit_findings.action: Map each incentive to its legal term, qualifying expenditures, employment or investment conditions, and expected expiration; normalize OE for finite benefits and rerun all scenarios and the buy-below price.

audit_findings.title: Growing related-party revenue may not be fully arm’s-length or durable
audit_findings.magnitude: $45.3 million of 2025 CinRx revenue, 1.8% of total revenue; first-half 2026 CinRx revenue declined to $9.6 million from $26.8 million
audit_findings.mechanism: Non-arm’s-length pricing, abnormal margins, weak collectability, or nonrecurring contracts could distort anchor OE and the assumed growth path.
audit_findings.evidence: During the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, the Company recognized total revenue from CinRx of $ 45.3 million, $ 28.3 million and $ 15.8 million in the Company’s consolidated statements of operations, respectively.
audit_findings.explanation: The related-party relationship and revenue amounts are demonstrated, but the record supplies no contract-level margins or comparable pricing with which to quantify the OE effect. The sharp 2026 revenue decline raises a durability concern, while the small revenue share and unknown profitability prevent the record from establishing materiality or even the direction of any pricing distortion.
audit_findings.action: Compare CinRx and LIB pricing, contribution margins, payment terms, collections, cancellations, and funding capacity with similar independent customers; calculate normalized related-party OE and rerun the valuation if the difference is material.
